messages:
Alex Chen: Hey folks — quick heads up: trying a slightly different ARB format for the next 4 meetings. Short lightning RFCs + one focused deep dive. Want to rotate facilitators weekly but allow 2-week swaps. Please pick your availability in the Doodle by EOD Thu: https://doodle.com/arb-rotate
calendar-bot: Event created: "ARB Engineering Roundtable" • Oct 5 10:30am PT • 45m • https://meet.redwood/arb-oct5
Maya Patel: I can facilitate Oct 5. Can I swap Oct 19 with Jordan? I have a release that week.
Jordan Li: I can take Oct 19 — no problem. Would like Oct 19 deep dive to be KV cache eviction perf work if that works.
Ravi Singh: Can we cap lightning RFCs at 6-8m each? We went over time last week and it killed the deep dive.
Alex Chen: Yes — new plan: 6-8m lightning RFC + 12-15m deep dive + 5m dedicated Q/A wrap. Will add a visual timer in the call.
Sam Torres: Also recommend adding a single line in the agenda for "Decisions & Owners" so action items are explicit.
Alex Chen: Good call — adding "Decisions & Owners" and "Parking lot" to the top of the agenda doc. Link: https://docs.redwood.dev/arb/agenda
Maya Patel: Quick facilitation checklist (copyable):
```
- Start on time (jump in 3m early to prep)
- Run lightning RFCs first (6-8m each)
- Deep dive owner gets 12-15m + 5m Q/A
- Ping author 1m before end to wind down
- Record decisions + assign owners in agenda doc
- Put follow-ups in parking lot with owners
```
Ravi Singh: Also +1 to 45m trial instead of 60m. Less fatigue and forces focus.
Alex Chen: Let's trial 45m on Oct 5. If it feels too tight we can revert. Thx for volunteering, Maya & Jordan. I'll update the calendar and facilitator rota in the doc. :thumbsup:
arb-bot: Reminder: Please upload RFC slides 24h before the meeting or they will be skipped for lightning slot.
Jordan Li: Thanks — I'll update the agenda and ping authors for slides.
Maya Patel: Done — filled my availability in Doodle and updated Oct 5 facilitator section. See you all there.
Alex Chen: Awesome. If anyone can't make their facilitator slot, please swap in the rota or ping me directly. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
